versions.changelog:
Initial release of aport-guardrail: pre-action authorization for AI agents.

- Enforces deterministic, policy-based tool authorization for OpenClaw, IronClaw, and PicoClaw agents before every tool call.
- Installer sets up config, plugin, and necessary script wrappers for automatic enforcement.
- Supports both local and hosted (API) passports; integrates with APort policy engine.
- Designed to be fail-closed, audit-ready, and impossible for agents to bypass.
- CLI and direct script call documentation provided; supports shell, messaging, git, MCP, and data export tools.
